articles.title: Nvidia buys Hugging Face for $12.9B in push into AI software
articles.summary: Nvidia agreed to buy Hugging Face for $12.93 billion, gaining a platform used by more than 18 million developers to share and deploy AI models.

articles.title: Is Germany's economic slump finally over?
articles.summary: Despite a slew of negative headlines, the German economy has posted its best figures in years. There are reasons for optimism, but structural issues remain.
